objective: Integrate immutable per-position async-memory state into native RD27 replay as default-disabled diagnostics, using explicit synthetic observations and preserving native outputs
summary: Native RD27 admission, boundary and close hooks drive a separate run-local sidecar registry. External typed booleans are canonically ordered; unknown/stale identities fail closed. Complete native outputs match disabled mode and the task-start implementation for all three native-loop policies. Default delegation remains intact; enabled delegated RD26 control is explicitly unsupported.
north_star_effect: Advances causal, testable exit-brain observation plumbing without introducing an exit rule, selecting economic thresholds or making a production/performance claim.

files.change: Narrow optional observer hooks; four-element native return tuple retained
New typed observation, collision-safe position identity and isolated diagnostics observer

implementation.diagnostics_argument: async_memory_diagnostics: dict[str, Any] | None = None; separately published only after a successful complete replay
implementation.identity: async_memory_position_id(pair, entry_time, sequence=1): collision-safe JSON tuple of pair, UTC native entry time and 1-based admitted-lifecycle sequence per pair. Not a pair-level state key; no inferred joins.
chronology: All input timestamps normalize to UTC and must lie on the replay's hourly boundary grid within its half-open window.
Canonical order is completed_at, full position_id, memory-before-trigger; list row order does not determine behavior. Exact duplicates are retained/countable; conflicting duplicates fail closed.
At native open t, externally asserted completed/available observations at t may represent only already completed information, not the unfinished OHLC row at t.
Existing positions observe before native exit evaluation. Native ordering among exits, admissions and completed-bar updates is otherwise unchanged.
New sidecars are created only after actual native admission and consume same-boundary observations before native entry-bar exit evaluation.
Every native close calls V1 reset, archives one terminal pre-reset summary and deletes active state/identity lookup.
After admissions and entry-bar exits, any unmatched observation is unknown/not-open and fails closed. No late reassignment or likely-position fallback.
Native output tuple and all pre-existing trade columns are unchanged. No sidecar value is returned to native exit, admission, size or capital logic.
implementation.disabled_behavior: No observer construction, no observation iteration/validation/processing and no diagnostics sink mutation. Existing delegated control behavior is unchanged.
implementation.delegated_control_scope: CONTROL_TIME_FAIL_72_FIXED_CAPITAL executes in RD26 without RD27 lifecycle hooks. Enabled shadow requests raise RD27ReplayError before delegation. No claim of enabled control coverage; no RD26 mutation or alternate trading path.
implementation.same_pair_scope: Native RD27 forbids simultaneous same-pair positions and this remains unchanged. Different pairs are isolated. Later same-pair lifecycles, including same-time entry-bar closes/re-admissions, receive distinct IDs and fresh state.
implementation.count_semantics: Processed/true observation counts include identical duplicate rows. Episodes and first latches count state transitions only. Duplicate count records unchanged V1 transitions.
implementation.per_position_records: One terminal summary per admitted position: ID, pair, entry time, memory seen, first/latest seen times, age at native close, episodes, previous observation, later-trigger latch/time, latest observation time, reset reason/time and cleared post-reset flags. No economic fields or ranking.

validation.initial_ruff: Three E501 line-length failures in new code/test; wrapped within the same admitted coding attempt with no semantic or assertion change
validation.full_native_output_parity: PASS: complete trade/daily dataframes, native metric dictionary values and counters; no shadow columns in trades
validation.independent_task_start_baseline_parity: PASS: immutable source from starting HEAD executed on synthetic fixtures; all three native-loop policies exactly match current enabled shadow outputs
validation.native_ast_check: PASS: original loop AST identical after removing explicit shadow-only guards/hooks/parameters and updated docstring; other native definitions unchanged
identity_cases: duplicate same-time admissions with entry-bar closes
error_cases: same-time first memory and true trigger
validation.economic_interpretation: Software parity on synthetic fixtures only; native synthetic bookkeeping is not an economic experiment or performance comparison

next_task_constraint: Observable adapter coding only: convert separately authorized causal observable inputs to this explicit interface; remain default-disabled/shadow-only. No trigger exit activation, historical predicate reconstruction, automatic research replay or economic study is authorized.
